objective: Measure whether removing known shared sources from the SPC fitting text bank changes COCO retrieval more than removing the same number of rows by a fixed whole-source random rule, with encoders unchanged.

research_design.stage: Exploratory full-bank follow-up. Earlier reduced-pilot outcomes are known. This is not a confirmatory preregistration or the complete published cross-dataset classification experiment.

budget.basis: Practical repeated-deletion allocation, not a power calculation. Finalize from resource evidence before new masks or fits, never from desired outcomes.

arms.O: All original SPC paragraphs; known source overlap retained as a diagnostic.
arms.C: O excluding every known COCO validation source.
arms.D: C excluding every known COCO training source. Remaining sources lack COCO mappings and are not independently established as different images.
arms.Rv: Whole-source subset of O with the same paragraph row count as C.
arms.Rp: Whole-source subset of C with the same paragraph row count as D.

source_identity.canonical: coco:<id> when mapped, otherwise vg:<id>; group all paragraphs and VG aliases of a source together.
source_identity.order: Original COCO train2014/val2014 identity, ascending numeric IDs; SPC paragraph-file order. Do not substitute later Karpathy split labels.
source_identity.unknown: Missing mappings remain unknown. Published loaders support row ordering, but tensors without embedded IDs do not independently attest it.

random_removal.rule: Rank whole source groups by (SHA256(UTF8(seed:source)), source), greedily retain groups that fit the exact remaining row budget, then restore original paragraph row order.
random_removal.failure: Stop if exact budget cannot be filled. No replacement seed, partial group or approximate count.
report: all pairwise row and source-group intersections

fitting.image_bank: All 82,783 image rows in every arm.
fitting.text_bank: Full selected bank, including repeated descriptions of retained sources.
fitting.rng: Fresh original Randomness(seed), consume original independent_split over full image and selected text populations, then pass the same advanced RNG to unchanged WassersteinProcrustes. Equal seeds do not imply identical later draws across unequal banks.
fitting.precision: Preserve original BF16 caption normalization/averaging before FP32 conversion.
fitting.centering: Each arm uses its own fitting-bank means, retaining no mean from excluded sources.
fitting.batch_dimensions: Configured cap stays 10,000; D and Rp use their actual 9,963 text rows. No padding or image cap.

evaluation.gallery: All 40,504 candidates for every query; never filter gallery by stratum.
evaluation.strata: Fixed original SPC membership: 37,169 never-known-exposed primary queries, 3,335 originally exposed diagnostic queries and all 40,504 diagnostic queries. Do not redefine after cleaning.
evaluation.rng: Fresh original evaluation RNG, full validation subset draw, then independent X and Y presentation shuffles.
evaluation.artifacts: Canonical per-query midranks, strictly-higher counts, tie-block sizes, COCO IDs and presentation permutations. Preserve original incoming-order overall metrics separately.
evaluation.recall: clamp((k-num_higher)/tie_count,0,1), expected credit under uniform order in exact tie block.

contrasts: Within seed and fixed stratum: F(C)-mean of all declared Rv mask scores.
Within seed and fixed stratum: F(D)-mean of all declared Rp mask scores.
Within seed and fixed stratum: F(C)-F(O).
Within seed and fixed stratum: F(D)-F(C).
reporting.aggregates: Every seed/mask score; arithmetic means and sample SD ddof=1. Form each contrast within seed before aggregation.
reporting.direction: Positive FOSCTTM differences mean worse retrieval; negative Recall differences mean worse retrieval.
reporting.missing: Enumerate every fit and attempt. Missing terms keep the affected contrast unavailable; no successful-subset average.
reporting.inference: Descriptive conditional variability only. No p-values, equivalence verdict, achieved-power claim, best seed/mask or naive query-level confidence interval. Masks share sources and are not independent corpora.

implementation.mask_budget: All explicit protocol selection seeds; no hardcoded random-mask count.
implementation.contrasts: Four within-seed contrasts for each of the three fixed strata, on all six metrics.
implementation.limits: Saved-rank/order/tie/metric consistency, not a new scoring of fitted maps or independent verification of failure causes.

interpretation_limits: Removing fitting paragraphs cannot remove encoder pretraining exposure.
All D sources lack COCO mappings; their independence is unknown.
Row-count controls do not match categories, style, group composition or mapping coverage.
Exclusion changes semantic evidence and centering as well as overlap, so effects do not isolate memorization.
Metadata identities do not exhaust image-byte or perceptual near-duplicates.
Fixed-pipeline retrieval does not generalize to all encoders or reproduce every classification endpoint.
research_design.ordering: Earlier reproduction and model panel remain ahead. After final source release: O,C,D, then Rv masks in declared order, then Rp masks in declared order; original algorithm seed order within each mask. One fit at a time unless a resource-based scheduling amendment is published before lock.

failure_policy.attempts: Fresh attempt before preflight; retain journals, maps, ranks and partial artifacts on failure. Keep private machine traces separate.
failure_policy.completion: Exactly one valid COMPLETE terminal marker, no conflicting FAILED marker, every required output hash verified, and final unchanged input/source/runtime byte checks. Both markers or partial markers are unavailable pending review.
failure_policy.retry: No automatic retry. Reviewed external execution/input failures may use a fresh numbered attempt with reason and predecessor hash; retain all attempts. No retry for an unfavorable score.
failure_policy.numerical_change: Separately named amended protocol, never relabelled as this frozen run.
failure_policy.selection: One verified COMPLETE attempt per scheduled mask/seed. Multiple COMPLETE attempts remain unavailable pending separately disclosed resolution; no score-based selection.
failure_policy.attempt_tree: cells/{mask}/seed-{decimal_seed}/attempt-{two_digit_positive_counter}; retain all attempts, begin at01 and require contiguous counters.

retry_review.file: retry-review.json inside fresh attempt, bound in its final terminal manifest
retry_review.previous_attempt: Immediately preceding counter. No retry after COMPLETE or conflicting terminal markers.
retry_review.previous_artifacts: Predecessor FAILED.json hash, or started.json hash only when no terminal marker exists.
retry_review.installation: Paired --retry-review and --retry-review-sha256 arguments copy and bind an existing reviewed record before preflight. The launcher must separately verify the predecessor's actual artifact bytes and stopped state; the runner neither approves nor automatically dispatches a retry.

release_order: Finish completed-full-run resource assessment; freeze budget before new masks or fits.
Review code/tests; bind original source/runtime, four tensors and complete metadata provenance.
Publish final scientific protocol and code release before the mask helper runs.

Rebuild source rows from all three verified archives, construct all masks/strata/compositions/intersections and complete schedule; publish the exact mask bundle and final outer execution lock before any fit.
Run every declared fit and independently reconstruct numerical summaries from ranks before interpretation.
research_design.privacy: Only public COCO/SPC inputs and IDs. Exclude private photographs, capture metadata, raw private features, private manifests and machine paths from publications.
research_design.remaining_goal: Prospective collection after a complete pre-capture lock, with fresh unpaired fitting and separate final evaluation.
draft_pending: Completed full-run cost evidence and final budget
Final protocol/code release and outer execution lock
Every actual mask and complete schedule
